name: Katherine
source:
It all begun when a new schoolmate joined your class. It was a bit strange this late in school year, but you don't care about that, beacuse this new nice girl is now sitting beside you. And that is just beggining...

[From: [url=http://lunaen.com/pages/katherine.html]denzil's homepage[/url]]
translation:
一切都始于一名新同学转入你的班级。学年已经过了这么久才转学，确实有些奇怪，但你并不在意，因为这个亲切可爱的少女如今就坐在你身旁。而这仅仅只是开始…

[摘自[url=http://lunaen.com/pages/katherine.html]denzil的主页[/url]]
